changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from sysobjects where name='ExecutionMetricMeasure' and xtype='U') begin create table api.ExecutionMetricMeasure ( ExecutionID uniqueidentifier not null, ItemNumber int not null, MeasureUid uniqueidentifier not null, Passed bit not null ) end
IF COL_LENGTH('[api].[ExecutionMetric]', 'Value') IS NULL BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionMetric add [Value] decimal(5,3) END
IF COL_LENGTH('[api].[ExecutionMetric]', 'RunDate') IS NULL BEGIN alter table api.ExecutionMetric add [RunDate] datetime END
